senses.gloss:
गृध् गृध्, i. 4, गृध्य, Par. To be greedy, Bhāg. P. 3, 3, 4; with loc., MBh. 3, 225; with acc., MBh. 4, 276. गृद्ध, Greedy, MBh. 5, 811.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To be greedy for (with loc.), MBh. 12, 372.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To be greedy for, (with acc.), MBh. 14, 847.
 --Cf. ἀγρήθετο; probably Goth. gredon, to hunger; gredus, gredags; λιμός; see गृध्र.
गृध्न गृध् + न, MBh. 13, 5640, Greedy, is probably to be changed to गृध्नु.
गृध्निनी गृध्निनी, Rām. 2, 79, 12, is to be changed to गृद्धिनी.

गृध्नु गृध् + नु, adj. Greedy, Megh. 9.
 --Comp.
गृध्या गृध् + या, f. Greediness, MBh. 13, 5590.

गृध्र गृध् + र,
 I. adj. Greedy, Pañc. i. d. 203.
 II. m. A vulture, Rām. 3, 20, 19.
 III. f. री, A female vulture, Yājñ. 3, 256.
 --Cf. Lat. vultur.
गृध्रवाजित गृध्रवाजित, i. e. गृध्रवाज + इत, m. An arrow, MBh. 14, 2454.
गृध्राण गृध्राण (akin to गृध्र), adj. Full of desires, Bhāg. P. 5, 17, 13.
गृध्र- + वाज गृध्र- + वाज, adj. adorned with a vulture's feathers, MBh. 9, 1413.
